high-unpleasant.subtext: Go with your gut — don't overthink it.

responses.label: My alarm went off
responses.subtext: Something triggered it — I feel on edge or afraid.

responses.label: A worry that won't turn off
responses.subtext: Always running in the background — I can't relax.

responses.label: About what others think of me
responses.subtext: Judgment, rejection, or being seen in a way I can't handle.

responses.label: I'm spiraling and can't stop it
responses.subtext: It keeps building and I can't slow it down.

responses.label: I don't know what triggered it
responses.subtext: Something's wrong but I can't name what started it.

responses.label: Heart racing, on alert
responses.subtext: Wired up — shallow breathing, can't sit still.

responses.label: Tense everywhere, scanning
responses.subtext: Tight muscles, on guard — my body won't let go.

responses.label: Shaking or crying, can't stop
responses.subtext: My body is doing things I can't control right now.

responses.label: Heat in face or chest, want to hide
responses.subtext: Flushing, shrinking — I want to disappear.

responses.label: I can't tell — it's all too much
responses.subtext: Everything's activated and I can't sort it out.

high-unpleasant.text: Are you having any thoughts of hurting yourself or ending your life?
high-unpleasant.subtext: Any answer is okay. It changes what we show you next.

responses.label: Yes
responses.subtext: Even a little, or on and off.

low-unpleasant.subtext: There's no wrong answer — just pick what's closest.

responses.label: Stuck on replay
responses.subtext: Same thoughts circling — I can't stop going over things.

responses.label: Quiet or blank
responses.subtext: Not much going on up there — just... empty.

responses.label: Far away or unreal
responses.subtext: Like I'm behind glass, or watching from the outside.

responses.label: I'm not sure
responses.subtext: I can't really tell what my mind is doing right now.

low-unpleasant.subtext: Focus on the physical sensation, not the emotion.

responses.label: Heavy or stuck
responses.subtext: Like there's a weight on me — I can't make myself move.

responses.label: Flat — nothing sounds good
responses.subtext: I could move, but nothing pulls me to. What's the point.

responses.label: Numb or disconnected
responses.subtext: Like my body isn't quite mine — or I can't feel it well.

responses.label: I can't really tell
responses.subtext: I'm not sure what my body feels like right now.
